description: The bar chart illustrates the effect of context masking perturbations on four morphosyntactic tags—case, gender, number, and tense—across six multilingual BERT model variants: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (pink), and XLM-B₂ (red), as indicated in the legend. The horizontal axis, labeled “tag,” lists the four linguistic categories in order: case, gender, number, and tense, while the vertical axis, labeled “effect,” spans from 0 to 20 with tick marks at intervals of 5. In the “case” category, mBERT-L₂ shows the highest effect, with a bar reaching approximately 17, followed closely by XLM-L₂ at around 16; mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ exhibit moderate effects (~12 and ~11, respectively), while mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂ show the lowest effects (~3 and ~2). In “gender,” all models show reduced effects compared to case, with mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ again among the highest (~4 and ~3), and XLM-L₂ nearly negligible (~0.5). For “number,” effects are generally low across all models, with mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ slightly elevated (~2.5–3) and others near 1–1.5. In “tense,” all models show minimal effects, mostly below 1, with XLM-B₂ and mBERT-B₂ slightly above 0.5. Error bars, representing standard deviation, are present for all bars and are notably larger in the “gender” category, indicating higher variability across model runs, while they are smallest in “tense.” The chart visually emphasizes that perturbations have the strongest impact on case distinctions, particularly for mBERT-L₂, and progressively weaker effects for gender, number, and especially tense, with XLM-B₂ consistently showing the lowest sensitivity across all categories except case.
caption_used: The bar chart illustrates the effect of context masking perturbations on various linguistic tags, categorized into case, gender, number, and tense. The horizontal axis represents the tag categories, labeled 'tag,' and includes case, gender, number, and tense. The vertical axis is labeled 'effect,' ranging from 0 to 20, with tick marks at intervals of 5 units. Each tag category features grouped bars representing different models or conditions, distinguished by specific colors corresponding to the legend: light blue for mBERT-L₂, dark blue for XLM-L₂, light green for mBERT-R₂, dark green for XLM-R₂, pink for mBERT-B₂, and red for XLM-B₂. In the 'case' category, mBERT-L₂ consistently exhibits the highest effect, with values exceeding 15, while XLM-B₂ shows the lowest effect, remaining below 5. The 'tense' category demonstrates a steady decline across all models, with values approaching zero. Error bars indicate the standard deviation, with the largest variability observed in the 'gender' category across all models.
